251	    """Keep masks over T's rows for every grid cell, built from the IS rows only (the rule reads the built as-of ledger; the rearm
252	    variant reads the IS outcomes of skipped SETUPs). Rows outside IS are left True and are never scored here."""
253	    rows = np.flatnonzero(T.is_mask); S = session_frame(T, rows)

259	        else: m = rearm_keep(S["net"], S["stop"], S["sess_first"], S["sess_run"], c["max_stops_today"], c["max_loss_today_inr"])
260	        full = np.ones(T.n, dtype=bool); full[rows] = m; masks[key] = full

264	def choose_cell(T, masks, tr):
265	    """Training-fold choice: the cell with the largest kept-vs-skipped diff among cells with kept_share >= 0.20; tie -> larger kept share."""
266	    best = None
267	    for key, m in masks.items():
268	        r = H.metrics(T, m, tr, tag="train", controls=False)
269	        if r["kept_share"] is None or r["kept_share"] < KEPT_SHARE_FLOOR or r["diff"] is None: continue
270	        cand = (r["diff"], r["kept_share"], key)
271	        if best is None or cand > best: best = cand
272	    return best

275	def branch_b(T, tf, out):
276	    log(f"[{tf}] branch B: the {len(all_cells())}-cell grid, nested choice, CPCV, go/no-go")
277	    masks = cell_masks(T); is_rows = np.flatnonzero(T.is_mask)
278	    grid_rows, vecs, keys = [], [], []
279	    for key, m in masks.items():
280	        cfg = json.loads(key)
281	        r = H.score(T, m, f"{STUDY}/grid", cfg, script=__file__)
282	        grid_rows.append(r); vecs.append(H.session_vectors(T, m, is_rows)); keys.append(key)
283	        log(f"  grid {cfg}: id {r['id']} kept {r['kept_n']} share {r['kept_share']} diff {r['diff']} ctrl {r['control_pct']} perm_p {r['perm_p']}")
284	    pd.DataFrame(grid_rows).to_csv(os.path.join(HERE, f"grid_{tf}.csv"), index=False)
285	    # nested choice inside the 12 purged training folds -> one OOF mask
286	    oof = np.zeros(T.n, dtype=bool); chosen_folds = []
287	    for b, (tr, te) in enumerate(H.purged_splits(T)):
288	        best = choose_cell(T, masks, tr)
289	        if best is None: chosen_folds.append(None); oof[te] = True; continue
290	        oof[te] = masks[best[2]][te]; chosen_folds.append(json.loads(best[2]))
291	    nested = H.score(T, oof, f"{STUDY}/nested", dict(selection="max diff | kept_share>=0.20 in training fold", folds=12), script=__file__)
292	    log(f"  nested OOF: id {nested['id']} kept {nested['kept_n']} diff {nested['diff']} ctrl {nested['control_pct']} perm_p {nested['perm_p']} sign_blocks {nested['sign_blocks']}")
293	    # CPCV: 66 splits -> 11 paths
294	    oof_split = {}
295	    for tr, te, (a, b) in H.cpcv_splits(T):
296	        best = choose_cell(T, masks, tr)
297	        oof_split[(a, b)] = (masks[best[2]][te] if best is not None else np.ones(len(te), dtype=bool)).astype(float)
298	    paths = H.cpcv_paths(T, oof_split)
299	    dist, path_rows = H.score_paths(T, paths, f"{STUDY}/nested", dict(selection="max diff | kept_share>=0.20 in training fold"), script=__file__, controls=True)
300	    log(f"  CPCV: {dist}")
301	    # the candidate: the cell chosen on all IS rows (its grid row is the ledger row)
302	    best_all = choose_cell(T, masks, is_rows)
303	    cand_cfg = json.loads(best_all[2]) if best_all else None
304	    res = next(r for r, k in zip(grid_rows, keys) if k == best_all[2]) if best_all else None
305	    fam = dict(pbo_diff=H.pbo(vecs, "diff"), pbo_kept_mean=H.pbo(vecs, "kept_mean"), spa=H.spa(vecs, tag=f"{STUDY}|{tf}"), effective_trials=H.effective_trials(vecs))
306	    go, checks, dsr, boot, combined = None, None, None, None, None
307	    if res is not None:
308	        vec = vecs[keys.index(best_all[2])]
309	        per = np.where(vec["kept_n"] > 0, vec["kept_sum"] / np.maximum(vec["kept_n"], 1), 0.0)[vec["kept_n"] > 0]
310	        srs = []
311	        for v in vecs:
312	            x = np.where(v["kept_n"] > 0, v["kept_sum"] / np.maximum(v["kept_n"], 1), 0.0)[v["kept_n"] > 0]
313	            if len(x) > 2 and x.std(ddof=1) > 0: srs.append(x.mean() / x.std(ddof=1))
314	        sr_var = float(np.var(srs, ddof=1)) if len(srs) > 1 and np.var(srs, ddof=1) > 0 else None
315	        dsr = H.deflated_sharpe(per, len(vecs), sr_var)
316	        boot = H.bootstrap_ci(vec, tag=f"{STUDY}|{tf}")
317	        go, checks = H.go_no_go(res, tf, cpcv=dist, pbo_value=fam["pbo_diff"]["pbo"], dsr=dsr, spa_p=fam["spa"]["spa_p"], boot=boot)
318	        log(f"  candidate {cand_cfg}: go={go} " + json.dumps(checks, default=str))
319	        comb = masks[best_all[2]] & T.F.fz_traded.astype(bool).to_numpy()
320	        combined = H.score(T, comb, f"{STUDY}/combined", dict(cand_cfg, and_gate="fz_traded (frozen ST7/ST8, comparator)"), script=__file__)

327	                             combined={k: combined[k] for k in ("id", "kept_n", "kept_share", "diff", "perm_p", "control_pct", "sign_blocks")} if combined else None))

332	def selftest():
333	    net = np.array([-1000.0, -2500.0, 3000.0, -1500.0, -1200.0, 500.0, -900.0]); stop = np.array([0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0], dtype=bool)

337	    rm = running_min_by_session(tn, sess_first, sess_run); assert np.allclose(rm, [0, -1000, -3500, -3500, 0, -1200, -1200])
338	    assert (grid_keep(ts, rm, 1, None) == [1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0]).all()

343	    assert (rearm_keep(net, stop, sess_first, sess_run, 1, None) != grid_keep(ts, rm, 1, None)).sum() == 2
344	    # rearm (k = 9, L = -3000): session 0 stops at position 1 (net -3500), 2 skipped and wins -> 3 taken; session 1 never stops
345	    assert (rearm_keep(net, stop, sess_first, sess_run, 9, -3000.0) == [1, 1, 0, 1, 1, 1, 1]).all()
346	    p = holm([0.01, 0.04, 0.03]); assert np.allclose(p, [0.03, 0.06, 0.06])
347	    s = stats7(tn, ts, net); assert np.isfinite(s[1]) and np.isnan(s[3])
348	    print("selftest ok")

2	the hindsight-free re-test of the study's question. Runs after session_stop.py; reads its results.json; never edits the ledger.
3	
4	    python session_stop_repair.py                 # full run (both timeframes, L1 primary, L0 robustness); new ledger rows carry note="repair"
5	    python session_stop_repair.py --dev DIR       # development: small draws, NO ledger row, outputs to DIR (never the study folder)

8	Issues (the refuters' report, condensed) and what this script does about each:
9	  I1  N1 (outcomes permuted within session x hour_bin cells over FIXED positions) is mis-specified: the positions are generated by
10	      the outcomes (a Foundation trade runs until exit and the next SETUP follows it, min gap 1 bar; winners hold ~6x longer than
11	      losers), so in a multi-member cell the early units are losers almost by construction and a long winner is the last unit;
12	      shuffling outcomes over fixed positions puts winners first, which the data almost never does, and the observed statistic
13	      sits above the permutation distribution in the "mean-reverting" direction with ZERO memory. -> (a) the mechanism table;
14	      (b) a memoryless generator (below) on which N1 is re-run: the share of memoryless streams N1 rejects; (c) two hindsight-free
15	      nulls N3 / N4 replace N1 as the entry condition; (d) the "session memory / mean-reverting / reverse rule" statements are
16	      withdrawn in FINDINGS.md / findings.json (write_findings.py).
17	  I2  The session-matched random control draws n_s of the N_s realized positions of the session; N_s is known only at session end
18	      and the last positions are long winners by construction, so for a within-session sequential rule (which keeps the earliest
19	      positions) the control is a hindsight-biased comparator. -> control_pct is reported but never used as evidence; every grid
20	      cell is judged on the hindsight-free pooled and within-hour kept-vs-skipped statistics, calibrated against the memoryless
21	      generator; harness.go_no_go is reported as computed AND without its control check; the orchestrator is flagged.
22	  I3  Judge 2's hour interaction was not run after the (as-run) rejection. -> 16 hour-conditioned cells (the rule active from

25	Definitions fixed before any repaired statistic was computed (also written to preregistration_repair.json before the first one):
26	  unit / ledger / hour_bin / 7 tests   as in session_stop.py (SS.stats7: Spearman(today_net_asof, own L1 net); mean net after
27	      >= k stops minus otherwise, k = 1, 2, 3; mean net when today_net_asof <= L minus otherwise, L = -2000, -4000, -6000 INR).
28	  memoryless generator   per active IS session: start at the session's real first SETUP bar, cut at its 15:25 bar (or last bar);
29	      at bar t draw a real IS unit j uniformly from the IS units of hour_bin(t) (the build's clock bins, checked bar by bar), give
30	      the stream unit j's (net, stop flag) and duration d_j = l1_exit_i - setup_i (variant "independent": the duration of a second
31	      independent draw from the same pool), exit at min(t + d, cut), next SETUP at exit + a gap drawn from the empirical
32	      within-session gap distribution (next setup_i - l1_exit_i, >= 1 always); repeat while t < cut. Outcomes are iid given the
33	      clock: no session memory by construction; the hour profile and the duration / position mechanics are those of the data.
34	  N3 (simulation null)   the 7 statistics computed on 2,000 memoryless streams (tied duration) = the null distribution of the
35	      OBSERVED statistic; p = min(1, 2 min(p_lo, p_hi)) with the +1 correction (p_lo = P*(stat* <= obs), p_hi likewise for >=);
36	      Holm over the 7 tests.
37	  N4 (stratified contrast, session-block bootstrap; PRIMARY)   the same 7 contrasts within hour_bin ACROSS sessions, so nothing
38	      conditions on the realized within-session positions: for the six threshold tests the stratified difference
39	      sum_h w_h (m_a,h - m_b,h) / sum_h w_h with w_h = n_a,h n_b,h / (n_a,h + n_b,h) over the strata holding both states (= the OLS
40	      coefficient of net on the state indicator with hour_bin fixed effects); for the Spearman test the partial rank correlation
41	      = Pearson correlation of the within-hour-bin demeaned ranks of today_net_asof and of net. Inference by the stationary block
42	      bootstrap of the active sessions (harness.stationary_bootstrap_idx, mean block 10, 2,000 draws; every unit of a drawn
43	      session enters), p = min(1, 2 min(P*(stat* <= 0), P*(stat* >= 0))) with the +1 correction, 90 % / 95 % percentile CIs;
44	      Holm over the 7 tests. Also computed on every memoryless stream (its centring check: the stat must be ~0 there) and with

47	      the signs of the rejected contrasts agree; exactly one of the two -> "inconclusive: not shown"; neither -> "no session

112	def tail_p(obs, dist):
113	    """Doubled-tail p of obs (vector) against dist (draws x tests), +1 corrected; also the two tails and obs's percentile."""
114	    obs = np.asarray(obs, dtype=float); dist = np.asarray(dist, dtype=float)
115	    valid = np.isfinite(dist) & np.isfinite(obs)[None, :]; n = valid.sum(axis=0)
116	    with np.errstate(invalid="ignore"):
117	        lo = (1 + ((dist <= obs[None, :] + 1e-12) & valid).sum(axis=0)) / (1 + n)
118	        hi = (1 + ((dist >= obs[None, :] - 1e-12) & valid).sum(axis=0)) / (1 + n)
119	        pct = 100.0 * (((dist < obs[None, :] - 1e-12) & valid).sum(axis=0) + 0.5 * ((np.abs(dist - obs[None, :]) <= 1e-12) & valid).sum(axis=0)) / np.maximum(n, 1)
120	    p = np.minimum(1.0, 2 * np.minimum(lo, hi))
121	    p = np.where(np.isfinite(obs) & (n > 0), p, np.nan)
122	    return p, lo, hi, pct, n

125	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the stratified (hindsight-free) statistics
126	def strat_diff(strata, cond, net):
127	    """OLS coefficient of net on cond with stratum fixed effects = sum_h w_h (m_a,h - m_b,h) / sum_h w_h, w_h = n_a n_b / (n_a + n_b)."""
128	    cond = np.asarray(cond, dtype=bool); ns = int(strata.max()) + 1
129	    na = np.bincount(strata, weights=cond.astype(float), minlength=ns); nb = np.bincount(strata, minlength=ns) - na
130	    sa = np.bincount(strata, weights=net * cond, minlength=ns); sb = np.bincount(strata, weights=net * (~cond), minlength=ns)
131	    ok = (na > 0) & (nb > 0)
132	    if not ok.any(): return np.nan
133	    w = na[ok] * nb[ok] / (na[ok] + nb[ok])
134	    return float(np.sum(w * (sa[ok] / na[ok] - sb[ok] / nb[ok])) / w.sum())

137	def partial_spearman(strata, x, y):
138	    """Pearson correlation of the within-stratum demeaned ranks of x and y (ranks over the whole sample)."""
139	    rx, ry = sst.rankdata(x), sst.rankdata(y); ns = int(strata.max()) + 1
140	    cnt = np.maximum(np.bincount(strata, minlength=ns), 1)
141	    rx = rx - (np.bincount(strata, weights=rx, minlength=ns) / cnt)[strata]
142	    ry = ry - (np.bincount(strata, weights=ry, minlength=ns) / cnt)[strata]
143	    if rx.std() == 0 or ry.std() == 0: return np.nan
144	    return float(np.corrcoef(rx, ry)[0, 1])

147	def strat7(strata, today_net, today_stops, net):
148	    out = np.full(7, np.nan)

151	    for j, L in enumerate(L_TESTS): out[4 + j] = strat_diff(strata, today_net <= L, net)

155	def holm(p):
156	    p = np.asarray(p, dtype=float); m = int(np.isfinite(p).sum()); adj = np.full(len(p), np.nan)
157	    order = [i for i in np.argsort(np.where(np.isfinite(p), p, np.inf)) if np.isfinite(p[i])]; run = 0.0
158	    for rank, i in enumerate(order):
159	        run = max(run, min(1.0, (m - rank) * p[i])); adj[i] = run
160	    return adj

209	def simulate(G, seed, tied=True):
210	    """One memoryless stream on the real session skeleton (see the docstring)."""
211	    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
212	    n_max = 8 * G["n_real"]; U = rng.random((3, n_max)); q = 0
213	    S_, Hc, J, Dd, Fi = [], [], [], [], []
214	    bar_hbc, pools, dur, gaps, fine_of_bar = G["bar_hbc"], G["pools"], G["dur"], G["gaps"], G["fine_of_bar"]
215	    ng = len(gaps)
216	    for s, t, c in zip(G["active"], G["first"], G["cut"]):
217	        t = int(t); c = int(c)
218	        while t < c:
219	            h = int(bar_hbc[t]); p = pools[h]
220	            if len(p) == 0: t += 1; continue
221	            if q >= n_max: raise RuntimeError("stream longer than 8x the real book")
222	            j = p[int(U[0, q] * len(p))]
223	            d = int(dur[j]) if tied else int(dur[p[int(U[1, q] * len(p))]])
224	            S_.append(s); Hc.append(h); J.append(j); Dd.append(d); Fi.append(int(fine_of_bar[t]))
225	            ex = min(t + max(d, 1), c)
226	            t = ex + int(gaps[int(U[2, q] * ng)])
227	            q += 1
228	    J = np.array(J, dtype=int)
229	    return stream_frame(np.array(S_, dtype=int), np.array(Hc, dtype=np.int8), G["net"][J], G["stop"][J], np.array(Dd, dtype=int), fine=np.array(Fi, dtype=np.int16))

566	def selftest():
567	    strata = np.array([0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 1]); cond = np.array([1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0], dtype=bool); net = np.array([1.0, 3.0, 0.0, 2.0, 10.0, 4.0, 6.0, 5.0])
568	    # stratum 0: m_a 2, m_b 1, w = 2*2/4 = 1; stratum 1: m_a 10, m_b 5, w = 1*3/4 = 0.75 -> (1*1 + 0.75*5) / 1.75 = 2.7142857
569	    assert abs(strat_diff(strata, cond, net) - (1 + 3.75) / 1.75) < 1e-12
570	    # equals the OLS coefficient with stratum fixed effects
571	    X = np.column_stack([cond.astype(float), (strata == 0).astype(float), (strata == 1).astype(float)]); beta = np.linalg.lstsq(X, net, rcond=None)[0]
572	    assert abs(beta[0] - strat_diff(strata, cond, net)) < 1e-9
573	    assert np.isnan(strat_diff(np.array([0, 0, 1, 1]), np.array([1, 1, 1, 1], dtype=bool), np.arange(4.0)))

"""Session-matched random-control percentile of the k=2 absorbing rule on the real book and on zero-memory streams."""
import sys, os, time
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
OUT = "/home/user/money-maker/research/strategy_lab/fz_v3/out"
sys.path.insert(0, OUT); sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath(os.path.join(OUT, "..", "..")))
import harness as H, fz_report

HOUR_ORDER = ["<09:25", "09", "10", "11", "12", "13", "14", "15", ">=15:20"]; HB = {h: i for i, h in enumerate(HOUR_ORDER)}
def hbin(h): return "<09:25" if h < "09:25" else ">=15:20" if h >= "15:20" else h[:2]
def ledger(net, stop, sess):
    new = np.r_[True, sess[1:] != sess[:-1]]; run = np.cumsum(new) - 1; first = np.flatnonzero(new)
    pn = np.cumsum(net) - net; ps = np.cumsum(stop.astype(int)) - stop.astype(int)
    return pn - pn[first][run], ps - ps[first][run]
def keep_k2(net, stop, sess):
    tn, ts = ledger(net, stop, sess); return ts < 2
def control(sess, net, keep, draws, tag):
    raw = [dict(day=str(int(s)), net=float(v)) for s, v in zip(sess, net)]; sel = [u for u, k in zip(raw, keep) if k]
    rc = fz_report.random_control(raw, sel, draws, H.SEED, tag); return rc["fz_pct"], rc["p_beat"]

T = H.load("minute", "L1"); rows = np.flatnonzero(T.is_mask); F = T.F.iloc[rows]
sess = F.session_idx.to_numpy(); net = T.net[rows]; stop = (F.l1_exit_reason.astype(str) == "stop_loss").to_numpy()
setup = F.setup_i.to_numpy(int); dur = F.l1_exit_i.to_numpy(int) - setup
hbc = np.array([HB[h] for h in F.hour_bin.astype(str)], dtype=np.int8)
k = keep_k2(net, stop, sess); assert (k == (F.today_n_stops_asof.to_numpy(int) < 2)).all()
t0 = time.time(); pct, pb = control(sess, net, k, 500, "refute|real|k2")
print(f"REAL k=2/L=none: kept {k.sum()} ({k.mean():.4f}); pooled diff {net[k].mean() - net[~k].mean():+.2f}; control pct {pct} p_beat {pb} ({time.time() - t0:.0f}s)")

B = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(H.DATA, "minute", "bars.parquet"), columns=["i", "datetime", "session_idx"])
hhmm = B.datetime.astype(str).str[11:16].to_numpy(); bar_hbc = np.array([HB[hbin(h)] for h in hhmm], dtype=np.int8); bs = B.session_idx.to_numpy()
last_bar = pd.Series(B.i.to_numpy()).groupby(bs).last(); at = hhmm == "15:25"
cut = pd.Series(B.i.to_numpy()[at]).groupby(bs[at]).first().reindex(last_bar.index).fillna(last_bar).astype(int)
active = np.array(sorted(set(sess.tolist()))); first = pd.Series(setup).groupby(sess).min().reindex(active).to_numpy(int)
nxt_same = np.r_[sess[1:] == sess[:-1], False]; gaps = (np.r_[setup[1:], 0] - F.l1_exit_i.to_numpy(int))[nxt_same]
pools = [np.flatnonzero(hbc == c) for c in range(9)]
def simulate(seed, tied):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed); S_, J = [], []
    for s, t, c in zip(active, first, cut.reindex(active).to_numpy(int)):
        t = int(t); c = int(c)
        while t < c:

import sys, os, time
import numpy as np, pandas as pd

sys.path.insert(0, OUT); sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath(os.path.join(OUT, "..", "..")))
import harness as H, fz_report

HOUR_ORDER = ["<09:25", "09", "10", "11", "12", "13", "14", "15", ">=15:20"]; HB = {h: i for i, h in enumerate(HOUR_ORDER)}
def hbin(h): return "<09:25" if h < "09:25" else ">=15:20" if h >= "15:20" else h[:2]
def ledger(net, stop, sess):
    new = np.r_[True, sess[1:] != sess[:-1]]; run = np.cumsum(new) - 1; first = np.flatnonzero(new)
    pn = np.cumsum(net) - net; ps = np.cumsum(stop.astype(int)) - stop.astype(int)
    return pn - pn[first][run], ps - ps[first][run]

    tn, ts = ledger(net, stop, sess); return ts < 2

    raw = [dict(day=str(int(s)), net=float(v)) for s, v in zip(sess, net)]; sel = [u for u, k in zip(raw, keep) if k]
    rc = fz_report.random_control(raw, sel, draws, H.SEED, tag); return rc["fz_pct"], rc["p_beat"]

hhmm = B.datetime.astype(str).str[11:16].to_numpy(); bar_hbc = np.array([HB[hbin(h)] for h in hhmm], dtype=np.int8); bs = B.session_idx.to_numpy()
last_bar = pd.Series(B.i.to_numpy()).groupby(bs).last(); at = hhmm == "15:25"
cut = pd.Series(B.i.to_numpy()[at]).groupby(bs[at]).first().reindex(last_bar.index).fillna(last_bar).astype(int)
active = np.array(sorted(set(sess.tolist()))); first = pd.Series(setup).groupby(sess).min().reindex(active).to_numpy(int)
